notes:
The cast keeps up.

Lines you have cast are now made ahead in the voice you gave them, so a conducted chapter plays without stopping to think. Before this, preparing a chapter would say “ready” and then pause on every line you had cast — which is exactly the ones you cared enough to conduct.

And you can fix a cast you got wrong. Long-press a name to rename them or give them a different voice; it takes effect on the next line and nothing needs re-tapping.
